blockedIdentities.detail: The repository raw identity STONE is not yet bound with sufficient certainty to the Stone Hydraulics brand owned by Hydraulic Technologies; the generic name must not be promoted on fuzzy matching alone.

profiles.shortDescription: Brevini publishes mechanical power-transmission products and hydraulic-electronic drive solutions.
fullDescription: The official Brevini company page establishes the brand identity and its work in mechanical transmissions.
The manufacturer-owned product directory covers industrial planetary gearboxes and associated power-transmission products.

profiles.shortDescription: Dinamic Oil develops planetary gearboxes, hoisting winches and drive solutions for mobile, marine and industrial machinery.
fullDescription: The official company site identifies Dinamic Oil as an Italian manufacturer founded in 1970 and specialising in winches and planetary gearboxes.
Its manufacturer-owned literature covers industrial, slewing, winch, track and wheel drives together with lifting winches and hoists.

profiles.shortDescription: ELMOT manufactures brake motors, electric wire-rope hoists, geared motors and crane components.
fullDescription: The official ELMOT product page establishes the company identity and its production of asynchronous conical-rotor motors with integrated brakes.
Published product groups include electric motors, wire-rope hoists, geared motors, industrial and special cranes and crane components.

profiles.officialName: FINDER Division of Gruppo Aturia S.p.A.
profiles.shortDescription: FINDER is the Gruppo Aturia oil-and-gas pump division for heavy-duty process pumps and engineered pumping systems.
fullDescription: The official Gruppo Aturia page identifies FINDER as its Oil & Gas division and connects the current division with the Finder Pompe heritage.
Its product scope includes API and ISO process pumps, vertical and overhung centrifugal pumps, between-bearings pumps, twin-screw pumps and sealless magnetic-drive pumps.

profiles.shortDescription: Herborner Pumpentechnik develops pumps for clean water, wastewater, marine systems and industrial processes.
fullDescription: The manufacturer-owned company page establishes the Herborner identity and its pump-technology scope.
Published product areas include swimming-pool and clean-water pumps, sewage pumps, marine pumps, block pumps and vertical industrial pumps.

profiles.shortDescription: Honeywell provides industrial automation, process-control, sensing, safety and warehouse-automation technologies.
fullDescription: The official Honeywell Industrial Automation directory establishes the company identity and its industrial product scope.
Documented groups include process control and safety systems, field instruments, gas measurement and detection, sensors and switches, drives, controllers, SCADA and warehouse-automation equipment.

profiles.officialName: INDEX-Werke GmbH & Co. KG Hahn & Tessky
profiles.shortDescription: INDEX TRAUB develops CNC turning machines, turn-mill centres and production automation for precision machining.
fullDescription: The official INDEX Group site identifies the INDEX and TRAUB brands and their CNC machine-tool portfolio.

Published groups include universal and production turning machines, turn-mill and turn-grind centres, vertical and multi-spindle machines, sliding-headstock machines, automation and machine-control software.

profiles.shortDescription: JUTEC develops bending machines and control systems for tube and profile forming.
fullDescription: The official JUTEC site establishes the German manufacturer identity and its bending-system specialisation.
Its product overview covers mandrel and mandrelless bending systems, control technology and machine platforms for industrial and workshop use.

profiles.shortDescription: Lightnin is an SPX FLOW brand for industrial mixers, agitators, impellers and engineered mixing systems.
fullDescription: The official SPX FLOW brand page establishes the Lightnin identity and its industrial mixing scope.
The published portfolio includes portable, top-entry, side-entry and sanitary mixers, magnetic mixers, line blenders, impellers and laboratory mixing systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Microprecision Electronics manufactures microswitches, limit and safety switches, and mechanical position sensors for demanding industrial applications.
fullDescription: The official company site identifies Microprecision Electronics SA as a Swiss manufacturer of standard and customised electrical switching components.

Its documented portfolio covers sealed microswitches, limit and safety switches, emergency-stop controls and precision mechanical sensors used in automation, machinery, transport, medical and telecommunications applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Pavone Sistemi develops industrial electronic weighing and force-measurement systems, including load cells, weighing instrumentation and scales.
fullDescription: Official Pavone Sistemi sources establish an Italian company developing industrial electronic weighing solutions since 1963.

Its product directory covers load cells, weight transmitters and indicators, dynamic and mobile weighing equipment, platform scales, dosing controls, web-tension systems and associated instrumentation.

profiles.shortDescription: SAACKE develops burners, combustion plants and thermal-process systems for industrial, marine and offshore applications.
fullDescription: The official SAACKE company profile confirms a Bremen-based manufacturer of burners and system solutions for industrial thermal processes, founded in 1931.

Its documented portfolio includes industrial and marine burners, combustion chambers, hot-gas generators, burner controls, fuel systems, marine boilers, waste-heat recovery units and gas-combustion units.

profiles.shortDescription: Schimpf manufactures electric actuators, control dampers and valves, and related drive components for industrial flow-control applications.
fullDescription: The manufacturer-owned site identifies Schimpf as an independent family business in Waldenbuch producing industrial electric actuators and their components.
Its product range includes actuator series, gas and air control dampers, high-temperature dampers, gas-flow control valves, gear units and actuator accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: SEIPEE manufactures configurable electric motors for industrial machinery, including asynchronous, brake, synchronous-reluctance and brushless designs.
fullDescription: The official SEIPEE site identifies an Italian electric-motor manufacturer based in Campogalliano and operating since 1972.

Its current range includes three-phase and single-phase asynchronous motors, brake motors, permanent-magnet brushless motors, synchronous-reluctance motors, ATEX motors, hygienic stainless-steel motors and medium- or high-voltage units.

profiles.shortDescription: SUNTEC develops gear pumps, gas-valve assemblies and pressure-control components for liquid- and gaseous-fuel systems.
fullDescription: Official SUNTEC sources establish a fluid-flow and pressure-control manufacturer created in 1984, with production operations in France and the United States.

The documented portfolio includes gear pumps for liquid fuels and micro-hydraulic applications, combined and multifunction gas valves, pressure switches, solenoid valves and associated fuel-control components.

profiles.shortDescription: UWT develops sensors and monitoring systems for point, continuous and interface level measurement in bulk solids and liquids.
fullDescription: The official UWT company profile confirms a German manufacturer of industrial level-measurement technologies, headquartered in Betzigau and operating since 1977.
Its portfolio spans rotary-paddle, vibrating, capacitive, radar, guided-radar and electromechanical sensors together with level-monitoring and visualisation systems.

profiles.shortDescription: Vickers by Danfoss supplies industrial hydraulic power and motion-control components, including pumps, motors, valves, cylinders and packaged systems.
fullDescription: Danfoss officially identifies Vickers as a continuing industrial-hydraulics brand that became part of Danfoss in 2021.
The current Vickers by Danfoss portfolio includes hydraulic pumps and motors, industrial valves, hydraulic and pneumatic cylinders, hydraulic power units, packaged systems, clutches and brakes.

profiles.shortDescription: Bauermeister develops grinding, milling and classifying machinery and plants for food, mineral and chemical processing.
fullDescription: The official company profile identifies Bauermeister Zerkleinerungstechnik GmbH as a Norderstedt-based manufacturer of grinding and classifying machinery and a member of the PROBAT Group.
Its machine portfolio includes impact mills, roller mills, flakers, laboratory mills, air classifiers and compact grinding systems for food, mineral and chemical materials.

profiles.shortDescription: Bekum develops extrusion blow-moulding machines and production systems for plastic packaging, technical parts and automotive components.
fullDescription: Official Bekum sources identify Bekum Maschinenfabriken GmbH as a Berlin-founded manufacturer of extrusion blow-moulding machines operating since 1959.
Its range covers electric and hydraulic packaging machines, large-container systems, automotive and 3D blow-moulding machines, extrusion heads, extruders, controls and automation.

profiles.shortDescription: OLAER is a legacy hydraulic accumulator and cooling-technology brand within Parker Hannifin. Parker continues to reference Parker Olaer accumulators, charging equipment and cooler products in its official portfolio.
fullDescription: Parker's official acquisition record identifies the former Olaer Group as a manufacturer of hydraulic accumulators and cooling technologies, integrated into Parker's Hydraulics business in 2012.
Current Parker materials retain the Parker Olaer name for bladder, diaphragm and piston accumulators, charging and monitoring accessories, and air/oil and water/oil cooling equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: OSLV Italia designs and manufactures vehicle windscreen-wiper systems and DC automation components. Its portfolio includes DC motors, gearmotors, linear actuators, wiper mechanisms, wiper motors, arms and blades.
fullDescription: OSLV Italia operates two product divisions: complete windscreen-wiper systems for vehicles and DC automation components.
The official product pages document motors, gearmotors and linear actuators alongside wiper mechanisms, wiper gearmotors, arms and blades, while the company history traces OSLV to 1968.

profiles.shortDescription: REDEX Group develops mechatronic systems for high-performance machine drives, precision rolling mills and metal-strip processing. Its portfolio includes linear and rotary axis drives, spindle and table drives, precision gearboxes, torque and tension controls, load cells, rolling mills and strip-processing lines.
fullDescription: REDEX Group is a European engineering company focused on machine-drive technology, precision rolling for wire and narrow strip, and continuous strip-processing equipment.
The official product directory documents rack-and-pinion axis drives, spindle gearboxes, precision reducers, torque and tension control systems, rolling mills and strip-processing technologies.

profiles.shortDescription: SIMACO develops industrial inks and specialist coatings for product and packaging coding. Its portfolio covers inkjet consumables, printing inks and application-specific coatings for materials and production environments.
fullDescription: The official SIMACO profile identifies the company as a specialist in industrial product and packaging marking and special coatings.

Its published product range includes inkjet and other printing inks, make-up fluids, cleaning consumables and coatings formulated for food, beverage, pharmaceutical, logistics, automotive, construction, ceramics and metalworking applications.

profiles.shortDescription: Spitzenreiter manufactures compressor and gas-separation equipment for industrial compressed-air and process-gas systems. Its range includes compressors, nitrogen and oxygen systems, air-treatment equipment and associated components.
fullDescription: The manufacturer's official company page identifies Spitzenreiter as a Russian producer of compressor and gas-separation equipment operating since 2005.

The published portfolio covers screw and reciprocating compressors, high-pressure and oil-free compressor systems, nitrogen and oxygen generation, dryers, filters, receivers and compressed-air preparation equipment.

profiles.shortDescription: Telco Sensors designs and manufactures optical sensing equipment for industrial automation. Its portfolio includes photoelectric sensors and amplifiers, light curtains, measuring light curtains, optical fork and frame sensors, and power-supply units.
fullDescription: The official Telco company profile identifies the business as a Danish designer, developer and manufacturer of photoelectric sensing products established in 1975.

Its product directory covers self-contained and remote photoelectric systems, industrial and measuring light curtains, optical fork and frame sensors, and supporting power units for detection, positioning, measuring, counting, sorting and verification.

profiles.shortDescription: WANGEN PUMPS develops positive-displacement pumps for industrial and hygienic fluid handling. Its main technologies are progressive-cavity pumps and twin-screw pumps for liquids, slurries and high-viscosity media.
fullDescription: Pumpenfabrik Wangen GmbH manufactures progressive-cavity and twin-screw pumps for industrial conveying, dosing and hygienic processing.

Official sources document product ranges for food and beverage, wastewater, biogas, agriculture, chemical and paper, pharmaceutical and cosmetic, and marine applications; the company has been part of Atlas Copco Group since 2022.

profiles.shortDescription: Wanner Engineering develops pumps for difficult industrial and process liquids. Its portfolio includes Hydra-Cell Pro seal-less diaphragm pumps, Pharma-Pro pumps, Vector peristaltic pumps and Stan-Cor centrifugal pumps.
fullDescription: Wanner Engineering was established in 1973 following the first Hydra-Cell patent and focuses on pump technologies for industrial equipment, process, metering and dosing duties.

Official product sources document Hydra-Cell Pro positive-displacement diaphragm pump families, Pharma-Pro hygienic pumps, Vector peristaltic pumps, Stan-Cor centrifugal pumps and pressure-regulating accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: ARGAL designs and manufactures corrosion-resistant pumps in thermoplastics, composites and metal alloys. Its range covers air-operated double-diaphragm pumps and centrifugal pumps for chemical, process and fluid-handling duties.
fullDescription: ARGAL has manufactured industrial pumps since 1975, with official company materials focused on thermoplastic, composite and corrosion-resistant alloy constructions.

The published range includes AODD and air-operated dosing pumps, magnetic-drive and mechanically sealed centrifugal pumps, vertical and sump pumps, self-priming pumps and FRP process pumps for corrosive, abrasive and demanding liquids.
